author: jalmena
tagline: Because "I think it was smaller" is not data.
description:
Self-hosted longitudinal tracking of your moles and skin marks: register them on a body map, photograph them
periodically against a physical reference, measure them with their uncertainty, compare observations over time
and take a report to your dermatologist. Your photographs never leave your server.

neVus is a personal documentation and measurement aid. It does not diagnose, screen for, or assess the risk of
any disease.

tips.before_install:
Set PUID and PGID to the owner of /DATA/AppData/nevus/data. For live camera capture and installation as an
app on your phone, serve neVus over HTTPS through your reverse proxy; uploading photos from the native camera
works over plain HTTP.

title: neVus
release_note:
1.3.0: the interface redrawn as one quiet application. An app bar with the way back and one primary
action within the thumb's reach; rows instead of cards; the occasional forms in sheets; the person's tools
and the settings as pages of their own; a rail on the desktop. Marks on a body map with dated looks and
scrubbed photographs; measurement against the reference card or a coin with its uncertainty, and the
shape and colour of each mark over time; comparison views and PDF reports for the clinician; reminders by
email, webhook, calendar feed or push notification; full-body sessions compared region by region; a second
factor, encrypted backups read back every week, and a trash. English, Spanish and Portuguese.
